q.zh: 成年昆虫有几只脚？
q.en: How many legs does an adult insect have?

why.zh: 昆虫有三对、共六只脚。
why.en: Insects have three pairs: six legs.
why.ms: Serangga mempunyai tiga pasang: enam kaki.

q.zh: 所有成年昆虫都有两对翅。
q.en: Every adult insect has two pairs of wings.
q.ms: Setiap serangga dewasa mempunyai dua pasang sayap.

why.zh: 有些只有一对翅（如蝇），有些没有翅（如蚂蚁工蚁）。
why.en: Some have one pair (flies) and some none (worker ants).
why.ms: Ada yang sepasang (lalat) dan ada yang tiada (semut pekerja).

q.zh: 把体区和它的工作配对。
q.en: Match each body part to its job.

why.zh: 头部负责感觉和取食，胸部负责运动，腹部负责消化和生殖。
why.en: Head: senses and feeding; thorax: movement; abdomen: digestion and reproduction.
why.ms: Kepala: deria dan makan; toraks: pergerakan; abdomen: pencernaan dan pembiakan.

q.zh: 蜘蛛有几只脚？
q.en: How many legs does a spider have?

why.zh: 蜘蛛是蛛形纲动物，有八只脚。
why.en: Spiders are arachnids, with eight legs.
why.ms: Labah-labah ialah araknid, berkaki lapan.

q.zh: 下面哪一种是昆虫？
q.en: Which of these is an insect?

why.zh: 蚂蚁有六只脚和三个体区。
why.en: Ants have six legs and three body parts.
why.ms: Semut mempunyai enam kaki dan tiga bahagian badan.

q.zh: 弹尾虫有六只脚，所以是昆虫。
q.en: Springtails have six legs, so they are insects.
q.ms: Ekor pegas berkaki enam, jadi ia serangga.

why.zh: 弹尾虫是六足动物，但不属于昆虫纲。
why.en: Springtails are hexapods but not insects.
why.ms: Ekor pegas ialah heksapod tetapi bukan serangga.

q.zh: 把动物和它的脚配对。
q.en: Match each animal to its legs.

why.zh: 蜈蚣每节一对脚，马陆每节两对，蜱是八只脚的蛛形纲动物。
why.en: Centipedes: one pair per segment; millipedes: two; ticks: eight legs.
why.ms: Lipan: sepasang setiap ruas; ulat gonggok: dua; sengkenit: lapan kaki.

q.zh: 蚂蚁的触角是什么形状？
q.en: What shape are an ant's antennae?

why.zh: 蚂蚁的触角在中间折成膝状。
why.en: Ant antennae bend like an elbow.
why.ms: Sesungut semut bengkok seperti siku.

q.zh: 哪一个只分得出明暗、帮助复眼？
q.en: Which only senses light and dark, helping the compound eyes?
q.ms: Yang manakah hanya mengesan terang dan gelap, membantu mata majmuk?

why.zh: 单眼感受光线强弱，在视觉上做辅助。
why.en: Ocelli sense light intensity and support the compound eyes.
why.ms: Oselus mengesan keamatan cahaya dan membantu mata majmuk.

q.zh: 把口器和昆虫配对。
q.en: Match the mouthparts to the insect.

why.zh: 蝽刺吸、蝴蝶虹吸、果实蝇舐吸。
why.en: Stink bugs pierce and suck, butterflies siphon, fruit flies sponge.
why.ms: Pepijat busuk menusuk, rama-rama menyedut, lalat buah menyerap.

q.zh: 螳螂的前足属于哪一种？
q.en: What kind of front legs does a mantis have?

why.zh: 螳螂的前足有刺，用来夹住猎物。
why.en: A mantis's spiny front legs seize prey.
why.ms: Kaki depan cengkadak yang berduri menangkap mangsa.

q.zh: 翅长在前胸上。
q.en: Wings grow from the prothorax.

why.zh: 翅长在中胸和后胸。
why.en: Wings grow from the mesothorax and metathorax.
why.ms: Sayap tumbuh dari mesotoraks dan metatoraks.

q.zh: 蝗虫会跳，是因为后足哪一节特别粗？
q.en: Grasshoppers jump because which part of the hind leg is enlarged?
q.ms: Belalang melompat kerana bahagian manakah kaki belakangnya membesar?

why.zh: 跳跃足的腿节特别粗壮。
why.en: Jumping legs have a greatly enlarged femur.
why.ms: Kaki melompat mempunyai femur yang sangat besar.

q.zh: 把足的类型和昆虫配对。
q.en: Match the leg type to the insect.

why.zh: 蝼蛄挖土、龙虱游泳、蟑螂快跑。
why.en: Mole crickets dig, diving beetles swim, cockroaches run.
why.ms: Anjing tanah menggali, kumbang penyelam berenang, lipas berlari.

q.zh: 甲虫坚硬的前翅叫什么？
q.en: What are a beetle's hard forewings called?
q.ms: Apakah nama sayap depan kumbang yang keras?

why.zh: 甲虫的前翅是鞘翅。
why.en: A beetle's forewings are elytra.
why.ms: Sayap depan kumbang ialah elitra.

q.zh: 哪一类昆虫的后翅变成平衡棒？
q.en: Which insects have hind wings reduced to halteres?
q.ms: Serangga manakah yang sayap belakangnya menjadi halter?

why.zh: 双翅目的后翅变成了平衡棒。
why.en: In flies (Diptera) the hind wings are halteres.
why.ms: Pada lalat (Diptera) sayap belakang menjadi halter.

q.zh: 昆虫的翅和鸟一样，是由前肢变来的。
q.en: Insect wings, like bird wings, evolved from front limbs.
q.ms: Sayap serangga, seperti sayap burung, berasal daripada anggota depan.

why.zh: 昆虫的翅不是由前肢变来的。
why.en: Insect wings did not come from limbs.
why.ms: Sayap serangga tidak berasal daripada anggota badan.

q.zh: 把翅和昆虫配对。
q.en: Match the wing to the insect.

why.zh: 甲虫是鞘翅，蝽是半鞘翅，蝴蝶是鳞翅。
why.en: Beetles: elytra; bugs: hemelytra; butterflies: scaly wings.
why.ms: Kumbang: elitra; pepijat: hemelitra; rama-rama: sayap bersisik.

q.zh: 腹末有一对钳子的是哪种昆虫？
q.en: Which insect has a pair of pincers at its tail?
q.ms: Serangga manakah yang mempunyai sepasang sepit di ekornya?

why.zh: 蠼螋的腹末有尾铗。
why.en: Earwigs carry forceps at the tail.
why.ms: Cocopet mempunyai penyepit di ekor.

q.zh: 昆虫通过身体两侧的气门呼吸。
q.en: Insects breathe through spiracles along their sides.
q.ms: Serangga bernafas melalui spirakel di sisi badan.

why.zh: 空气从气门进入体内的气管。
why.en: Air enters the breathing tubes through the spiracles.
why.ms: Udara masuk ke salur pernafasan melalui spirakel.

q.zh: 把构造和用途配对。
q.en: Match each part to its use.

why.zh: 产卵器产卵，气门呼吸，雄蝉用发音器鸣叫。
why.en: Ovipositor: eggs; spiracles: breathing; sound organs: the cicada's song.
why.ms: Ovipositor: telur; spirakel: bernafas; organ bunyi: nyanyian riang-riang.

q.zh: 学名的哪一部分首字母要大写？
q.en: Which part of a scientific name starts with a capital letter?
q.ms: Bahagian manakah nama saintifik bermula dengan huruf besar?

why.zh: 属名首字母大写，种小名全部小写。
why.en: The genus is capitalised; the species name is lower case.
why.ms: Genus berhuruf besar; nama spesies berhuruf kecil.

q.zh: 昆虫纲属于哪一个门？
q.en: Which phylum does the class Insecta belong to?
q.ms: Kelas Insecta tergolong dalam filum mana?

why.zh: 昆虫属于节肢动物门。
why.en: Insects are in the phylum Arthropoda.
why.ms: Serangga tergolong dalam filum Arthropoda.

q.zh: 命名者和年份放在括号里，表示这个物种后来被移到另一个属。
q.en: Brackets around the author and year mean the species has been moved to another genus.
q.ms: Kurungan pada pengarang dan tahun bermaksud spesies itu telah dipindahkan ke genus lain.

why.zh: 这是动物命名法规的规定。
why.en: That is the rule in the zoological code.
why.ms: Itulah peraturan dalam kod zoologi.

q.zh: 把阶层和例子配对。
q.en: Match the rank to the example.

why.zh: 昆虫纲是纲，鞘翅目是目，瓢虫科是科。
why.en: Insecta is a class, Coleoptera an order, Coccinellidae a family.
why.ms: Insecta ialah kelas, Coleoptera order, Coccinellidae famili.

q.zh: 左图的前翅是硬壳，在背中央对齐。这是哪一目？
q.en: On the left, the forewings are hard shells meeting down the middle. Which order?
q.ms: Di kiri, sayap depan ialah cangkerang keras yang bertemu di tengah. Order apa?

why.zh: 翅鞘在背中线对齐是甲虫的特征。
why.en: Elytra meeting in a straight line mark a beetle.
why.ms: Elitra yang bertemu dalam garis lurus menandakan kumbang.

q.zh: 左图的前足像镰刀。这是哪一类昆虫？
q.en: On the left, the front legs are like folding blades. Which insect?
q.ms: Di kiri, kaki depan seperti pisau lipat. Serangga apa?

why.zh: 捕捉足是螳螂的特征。
why.en: Grasping front legs mark a mantis.
why.ms: Kaki depan penangkap menandakan cengkadak.

q.zh: 左图只有一对翅，后面有一对小棒。这是哪一目？
q.en: On the left: one pair of wings and two tiny knobs behind. Which order?
q.ms: Di kiri: sepasang sayap dan dua tombol kecil di belakang. Order apa?

why.zh: 一对翅加平衡棒是双翅目。
why.en: One pair of wings plus halteres means Diptera.
why.ms: Sepasang sayap dan halter bermaksud Diptera.

q.zh: 检索表得出的结果一定正确。
q.en: A key's answer is always right.

why.zh: 检索表只适用于常见昆虫，有例外，要逐项核对。
why.en: Keys cover common insects only and have exceptions; check the features.
why.ms: Kunci hanya untuk serangga biasa dan ada pengecualian; semak cirinya.

q.zh: 完全变态的四个阶段，顺序是？
q.en: The four stages of complete metamorphosis, in order?
q.ms: Empat peringkat metamorfosis lengkap, mengikut urutan?

options.zh: 卵 → 若虫 → 成虫 → 蛹
卵 → 幼虫 → 蛹 → 成虫
幼虫 → 卵 → 蛹 → 成虫

why.zh: 卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫。
why.en: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.
why.ms: Telur, larva, pupa, dewasa.

q.zh: 蝗虫是哪一种发育方式？
q.en: How do grasshoppers grow up?

why.zh: 直翅目是不完全变态：卵、若虫、成虫。
why.en: Orthoptera: egg, nymph, adult.
why.ms: Orthoptera: telur, nimfa, dewasa.

q.zh: 袋蛾什么时候用药效果最好？
q.en: When does chemical control of bagworms work best?
q.ms: Bilakah kawalan kimia ulat bungkus paling berkesan?

why.zh: MPOB 建议在幼虫早期和中期用药。
why.en: MPOB advises treating early and middle larvae.
why.ms: MPOB menasihatkan rawatan pada larva awal dan pertengahan.

q.zh: 把幼虫类型和昆虫配对。
q.en: Match the larva to the insect.

why.zh: 金龟的幼虫是蛴螬型，蛾是蠋型，蝇是无足的蛆。
why.en: Beetle grubs, moth caterpillars, fly maggots.
why.ms: Gendon kumbang, ulat kupu-kupu, berenga lalat.

q.zh: Coleoptera 这个名字是什么意思？
q.en: What does Coleoptera mean?

why.zh: koleos 是鞘，pteron 是翅。
why.en: Koleos is sheath; pteron is wing.
why.ms: Koleos ialah sarung; pteron ialah sayap.

q.zh: 甲虫是完全变态的昆虫。
q.en: Beetles have complete metamorphosis.

why.zh: 甲虫经过卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫四个阶段。
why.en: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.
why.ms: Telur, larva, pupa, dewasa.

q.zh: 下面哪一种是甲虫？
q.en: Which of these is a beetle?

why.zh: 萤火虫属于鞘翅目。
why.en: Fireflies are beetles.
why.ms: Kelip-kelip ialah kumbang.

q.zh: 蝴蝶的触角是什么样子？
q.en: What do butterfly antennae look like?

why.zh: 蝴蝶的触角细长，末端膨大。
why.en: Butterfly antennae end in a club.
why.ms: Sesungut rama-rama berbonjol di hujung.

q.zh: 毛虫是鳞翅目的幼虫。
q.en: Caterpillars are the larvae of Lepidoptera.

why.zh: 蝶和蛾的幼虫是毛虫。
why.en: Butterfly and moth larvae are caterpillars.
why.ms: Larva rama-rama dan kupu-kupu ialah ulat.

q.zh: 把触角和昆虫配对。
q.en: Match the antennae to the insect.

why.zh: 蝴蝶棍棒状，蛾羽状或锯齿状，弄蝶末端有钩。
why.en: Butterflies: clubbed; moths: feathery or saw-edged; skippers: hooked.
why.ms: Rama-rama: berbonjol; kupu-kupu: berbulu atau bergerigi; skipper: bercangkuk.

q.zh: 半翅目的口器是哪一种？
q.en: What mouthparts do Hemiptera have?

why.zh: 半翅目用针管状口器刺吸汁液。
why.en: Hemiptera pierce and suck with a beak.
why.ms: Hemiptera menusuk dan menghisap dengan paruh.

q.zh: 蝉和蚜虫属于半翅目。
q.en: Cicadas and aphids belong to Hemiptera.
q.ms: Riang-riang dan afid tergolong dalam Hemiptera.

why.zh: 它们和蝽一样有刺吸式口器，只是翅全部是膜质。
why.en: Like true bugs they have a sucking beak; their wings are wholly membranous.
why.ms: Seperti pepijat, ia mempunyai paruh penghisap; sayapnya bermembran sepenuhnya.

q.zh: 哪一种是半翅目的害虫？
q.en: Which pest belongs to Hemiptera?

why.zh: 飞虱用刺吸式口器吸稻株汁液。
why.en: Planthoppers suck rice sap with their beak.
why.ms: Bena perang menghisap cecair padi dengan paruhnya.

q.zh: 怎样分辨有翅的蚂蚁和有翅的白蚁？
q.en: How do you tell a winged ant from a winged termite?
q.ms: Bagaimana membezakan semut bersayap daripada anai-anai bersayap?

options.en: Ants have a narrow waist and elbowed antennae
options.ms: Semut mempunyai pinggang sempit dan sesungut bersiku

why.zh: 白蚁触角念珠状、没有细腰。
why.en: Termites have bead-like antennae and no waist.
why.ms: Anai-anai mempunyai sesungut seperti manik dan tiada pinggang.

q.zh: 膜翅目是完全变态的昆虫。
q.en: Hymenoptera have complete metamorphosis.

why.zh: 蜂和蚂蚁有卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫四个阶段。
why.en: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.
why.ms: Telur, larva, pupa, dewasa.

q.zh: Hymenoptera 的 hymen 是什么意思？
q.en: What does 'hymen' in Hymenoptera mean?

why.zh: hymen 是薄膜，pteron 是翅。
why.en: Hymen is membrane; pteron is wing.
why.ms: Hymen ialah membran; pteron ialah sayap.

q.zh: 蝇的后翅变成了什么？
q.en: What have a fly's hind wings become?
q.ms: Sayap belakang lalat telah menjadi apa?

why.zh: 双翅目的后翅变成平衡棒。
why.en: Diptera hind wings are halteres.
why.ms: Sayap belakang Diptera ialah halter.

q.zh: 马蝇像蜜蜂，但不会螫人。
q.en: Horse bot flies look like bees but cannot sting.
q.ms: Lalat bot kuda seperti lebah tetapi tidak boleh menyengat.

why.zh: 它们只有一对翅，没有螫针。
why.en: They have one pair of wings and no sting.
why.ms: Ia bersayap sepasang dan tiada sengat.

q.zh: 蚊的触角是什么样子？
q.en: What are a mosquito's antennae like?

why.zh: 蚊属于长角亚目，触角细长。
why.en: Mosquitoes have long antennae.
why.ms: Nyamuk mempunyai sesungut panjang.

q.zh: 蝗虫和螽斯最容易用什么分开？
q.en: What best tells a grasshopper from a katydid?
q.ms: Apakah cara terbaik membezakan belalang dan katidid?

why.zh: 螽斯、蟋蟀触角细长；蝗虫触角短粗。
why.en: Katydids and crickets have long thin antennae; grasshoppers short thick ones.
why.ms: Katidid dan cengkerik bersesungut panjang halus; belalang pendek tebal.

q.zh: 蝼蛄的前足是挖掘足。
q.en: A mole cricket's front legs are digging legs.
q.ms: Kaki depan anjing tanah ialah kaki penggali.

why.zh: 蝼蛄用铲状前足挖土。
why.en: Mole crickets dig with spade-like front legs.
why.ms: Anjing tanah menggali dengan kaki depan seperti penyodok.

q.zh: 直翅目是哪一种发育方式？
q.en: How do Orthoptera develop?

why.zh: 直翅目：卵、若虫、成虫。
why.en: Egg, nymph, adult.
why.ms: Telur, nimfa, dewasa.

q.zh: 停下时把翅合起在背上的通常是？
q.en: Which usually rests with its wings closed over the back?
q.ms: Yang manakah biasanya berehat dengan sayap tertutup?

why.zh: 豆娘停下时多合起翅，蜻蜓平展翅。
why.en: Damselflies close their wings; dragonflies hold them out.
why.ms: Pepatung jarum menutup sayap; pepatung membentangkannya.

q.zh: 蜻蜓的若虫在水中生活。
q.en: Dragonfly nymphs live in water.

why.zh: 水生的若虫叫稚虫。
why.en: Water-dwelling nymphs are called naiads.
why.ms: Nimfa akuatik dipanggil naiad.

q.zh: 蜻蜓的两眼通常？
q.en: A dragonfly's eyes usually…

options.zh: 在头顶相接或几乎相接
options.en: Meet or nearly meet on top of the head
options.ms: Bertemu atau hampir bertemu di atas kepala

why.zh: 豆娘两眼分开，蜻蜓两眼相接。
why.en: Damselflies' eyes are far apart; dragonflies' meet.
why.ms: Mata pepatung jarum berjauhan; mata pepatung bertemu.

q.zh: 螳螂的前足叫什么？
q.en: What are a mantis's front legs called?

why.zh: 螳螂的前足是捕捉足。
why.en: Mantids have grasping front legs.
why.ms: Cengkadak mempunyai kaki depan penangkap.

q.zh: 螳螂是不完全变态。
q.en: Mantids have incomplete metamorphosis.

why.zh: 螳螂：卵、若虫、成虫。
why.en: Egg, nymph, adult.
why.ms: Telur, nimfa, dewasa.

q.zh: 螳螂吃什么？
q.en: What do mantids eat?

why.zh: 螳螂是捕食者。
why.en: Mantids are predators.
why.ms: Cengkadak ialah pemangsa.

q.zh: 白蚁和蚂蚁是近亲。
q.en: Termites are close relatives of ants.

why.zh: 白蚁属于蜚蠊目，是蟑螂的近亲；蚂蚁属于膜翅目。
why.en: Termites are Blattodea, related to cockroaches; ants are Hymenoptera.
why.ms: Anai-anai tergolong dalam Blattodea, saudara lipas; semut dalam Hymenoptera.

q.zh: 白蚁的触角是什么形状？
q.en: What shape are termite antennae?

why.zh: 白蚁的触角像一串珠。
why.en: Termite antennae are bead-like.
why.ms: Sesungut anai-anai seperti manik.

q.zh: 以前白蚁属于哪一目？
q.en: Which order were termites placed in before?
q.ms: Dalam order manakah anai-anai diletakkan dahulu?

why.zh: 白蚁以前是等翅目，现在归入蜚蠊目。
why.en: Termites were Isoptera; now they are Blattodea.
why.ms: Anai-anai dahulu Isoptera; kini Blattodea.

q.zh: Phasmida 的 phasma 是什么意思？
q.en: What does 'phasma' mean?

why.zh: phasma 是幻影。
why.en: Phasma means apparition.
why.ms: Phasma bermaksud bayangan.

q.zh: 竹节虫的前足是捕捉足。
q.en: Stick insects have grasping front legs.
q.ms: Serangga ranting mempunyai kaki depan penangkap.

why.zh: 捕捉足是螳螂的特征。
why.en: Grasping front legs belong to mantids.
why.ms: Kaki depan penangkap ialah ciri cengkadak.

q.zh: 马来半岛已知的竹节虫大约有多少种？
q.en: About how many stick insect species are known from Peninsular Malaysia?
q.ms: Kira-kira berapa spesies serangga ranting diketahui di Semenanjung Malaysia?

why.zh: Seow-Choen（2021）记录约 136 种。
why.en: Seow-Choen (2021) recognises about 136.
why.ms: Seow-Choen (2021) mengiktiraf kira-kira 136.

q.zh: 蓟马大约多大？
q.en: About how big is a thrips?

why.zh: 成虫约 1–2 毫米，要用放大镜看。
why.en: Adults are about 1–2 mm; use a hand lens.
why.ms: Dewasa kira-kira 1–2 mm; gunakan kanta pembesar.

q.zh: 蓟马除了吃植物，还会传播植物病毒。
q.en: Besides feeding, thrips can spread plant viruses.
q.ms: Selain makan, trips boleh menyebarkan virus tumbuhan.

why.zh: 金马仑的研究指出它们是病毒的传播者。
why.en: The Cameron Highlands study notes they are virus vectors.
why.ms: Kajian Cameron Highlands menyatakan ia vektor virus.

q.zh: 蓟马翅的特点是？
q.en: What is special about thrips wings?

why.zh: Thysanoptera 意思就是缨翅。
why.en: Thysanoptera means fringe-winged.
why.ms: Thysanoptera bermaksud bersayap jumbai.

q.zh: 蠼螋最明显的特征是？
q.en: An earwig's most obvious feature?

why.zh: 蠼螋腹末有尾铗。
why.en: Earwigs have tail forceps.
why.ms: Cocopet mempunyai penyepit ekor.

q.zh: 隐翅虫也有尾铗。
q.en: Rove beetles also have tail pincers.
q.ms: Kumbang rove juga mempunyai penyepit ekor.

why.zh: 隐翅虫的翅鞘也很短，但没有尾铗。
why.en: Rove beetles have very short wing covers but no pincers.
why.ms: Kumbang rove mempunyai penutup sayap pendek tetapi tiada penyepit.

q.zh: Dermaptera 的 derma 是什么意思？
q.en: What does 'derma' mean?

why.zh: derma 是皮。
why.en: Derma means skin.
why.ms: Derma bermaksud kulit.

q.zh: 蚁蛉的幼虫怎样捕食？
q.en: How do antlion larvae catch prey?

why.zh: 幼虫在沙地造沙阱。
why.en: The larvae dig sand pits.
why.ms: Larva menggali perangkap pasir.

q.zh: 脉翅目是完全变态。
q.en: Neuroptera have complete metamorphosis.

why.zh: 脉翅目经过卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫。
why.en: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.
why.ms: Telur, larva, pupa, dewasa.

q.zh: 草蛉的翅是什么样子？
q.en: What are lacewing wings like?

why.zh: 脉翅目的翅像透明的网。
why.en: Lacewing wings look like clear nets.
why.ms: Sayap lacewing seperti jaring jernih.

q.zh: 蜉蝣成虫的翅怎样摆？
q.en: How do adult mayflies hold their wings?
q.ms: Bagaimana lalat sehari dewasa meletakkan sayapnya?

why.zh: 蜉蝣的翅竖立合在背上。
why.en: Mayflies hold their wings upright.
why.ms: Lalat sehari menegakkan sayapnya.

q.zh: 怎样分蜉蝣和石蝇？
q.en: How do you tell a mayfly from a stonefly?
q.ms: Bagaimana membezakan lalat sehari dan lalat batu?

options.zh: 石蝇每只脚两个爪、两条尾须
options.en: Stoneflies have two claws per foot and two tails
options.ms: Lalat batu mempunyai dua kuku setiap kaki dan dua ekor

why.zh: 蜉蝣每只脚一个爪，稚虫腹部有叶状鳃。
why.en: Mayflies have one claw per foot, and nymphs have leaf-like gills.
why.ms: Lalat sehari mempunyai satu kuku setiap kaki, dan nimfanya ada insang seperti daun.

q.zh: 蜉蝣的稚虫生活在水中。
q.en: Mayfly nymphs live in water.
q.ms: Nimfa lalat sehari hidup dalam air.

why.zh: 稚虫用腹部两侧的鳃呼吸。
why.en: They breathe with gills along the abdomen.
why.ms: Ia bernafas dengan insang di sepanjang abdomen.

q.zh: 石蛾和蛾怎样分？
q.en: How do you tell a caddisfly from a moth?
q.ms: Bagaimana membezakan lalat kadis dan kupu-kupu?

options.zh: 石蛾翅上是毛，蛾翅上是鳞
options.en: Caddisfly wings are hairy, moth wings scaly
options.ms: Sayap lalat kadis berbulu, sayap kupu-kupu bersisik

why.zh: 蛾的触角常羽状或锯齿状，石蛾的细长如线。
why.en: Moths often have feathery or saw-edged antennae; caddisflies thread-like.
why.ms: Kupu-kupu sering bersesungut berbulu atau bergerigi; lalat kadis seperti benang.

q.zh: 石蛾是完全变态。
q.en: Caddisflies have complete metamorphosis.

why.zh: 毛翅目经过卵、幼虫、蛹、成虫。
why.en: Egg, larva, pupa, adult.
why.ms: Telur, larva, pupa, dewasa.

q.zh: Trichoptera 的 thrix 是什么意思？
q.en: What does 'thrix' mean?

why.zh: thrix 是毛。
why.en: Thrix means hair.
why.ms: Thrix bermaksud rambut.

q.zh: 衣鱼的尾端有几条长丝？
q.en: How many tail threads does a silverfish have?

why.zh: 衣鱼尾端有三条长丝。
why.en: Silverfish have three tail threads.
why.ms: Gegat mempunyai tiga ekor.

q.zh: 衣鱼长大后还会继续蜕皮。
q.en: Silverfish keep moulting after they are adult.
q.ms: Gegat terus bersalin kulit selepas dewasa.

why.zh: 无变态的昆虫性成熟后仍会蜕皮。
why.en: Ametabolous insects moult even after maturing.
why.ms: Serangga ametabola bersalin kulit walaupun selepas matang.

q.zh: 衣鱼在家里会损坏什么？
q.en: What do silverfish damage at home?
q.ms: Apakah yang dirosakkan gegat di rumah?

why.zh: 衣鱼会咬坏书本。
why.en: Silverfish damage books.
why.ms: Gegat merosakkan buku.

q.zh: 鱼蛉属于哪一目？
q.en: Which order do fishflies belong to?

why.zh: 鱼蛉和齿蛉都属于广翅目。
why.en: Fishflies and dobsonflies are Megaloptera.
why.ms: Fishfly dan dobsonfly ialah Megaloptera.

q.zh: 跳蚤的身体是怎样扁的？
q.en: How is a flea's body flattened?

why.zh: 跳蚤身体左右扁平，便于在毛发间穿行。
why.en: Fleas are flattened sideways.
why.ms: Kutu leper dari sisi ke sisi.

q.zh: 纺足目的雌虫没有翅。
q.en: Female webspinners are wingless.

why.zh: 纺足目雌虫无翅，前足能吐丝。
why.en: Females are wingless; the front feet spin silk.
why.ms: Betina tidak bersayap; tapak kaki depan memintal sutera.
